name: newtab-showcase
description: Remotion showcase video for the newtab page, synced to the music

scripts.audio: python3 audio/analyse_beats.py && python3 audio/make_sfx.py && bash audio/mix.sh
scripts.build: npm run render && npm run audio && bash audio/mux.sh
scripts.build:tour: npm run render:tour && npm run audio:tour && ffmpeg -v error -i out/tour-video.mp4 -i audio/tour-mix.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest -movflags +faststart -y out/newtab-tour.mp4 && echo 'out/newtab-tour.mp4 ready'

author: Sam Thomas
